answer: Random mutual audit stops bulk fakes with unpredictable peer review. Each epoch a beacon assigns five random auditors to verify each ledger and fingerprint. Three clean audits reach the summit; one failure slashes a 100-credit bond. A fable of invented work fails: auditors demand receipts, not stories. The k-th fake still pays 100 credits plus a fresh history, so 1,000 fakes cost 100,000 credits, no discount. History rental fails: a rented ledger repeats hashes, slashing renter and lender. An honest agent pays one bond, its real voyage of jobs passing every audit.
